source(output(
		Gender as string,
		{Medicaid Subscriber ID} as string,
		{Member Product} as string,
		{Account Name} as string,
		{Date of Birth} as date,
		Age as integer,
		{Medicaid Start Date} as date,
		{Ethnic Group} as string,
		{Plan Site: Site Name} as string,
		{Call List } as string,
		Measures as string,
		{New Member or Exixting Mbr} as string,
		PhoneNumber as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	procedureName: '',
	schemaName: '',
	resultSet: true,
	format: 'procedure',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(Measures_Unicode = Measures,
		PhoneNumber_Unicode = PhoneNumber,
		Gender_Unicode = Gender) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{Ethnic Group_Unicode} as string,
		{Medicaid Subscriber ID_Unicode} as string,
		{Plan Site: Site Name_Unicode} as string,
		{Date of Birth} as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Measures_Unicode as string,
		{New Member or Exixting Mbr_Unicode} as string,
		{Call List_Unicode} as string,
		{Member Product_Unicode} as string,
		{Account Name_Unicode} as string,
		Gender_Unicode as string,
		{Medicaid Start Date} as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Age as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
